description: This file provides a mock implementation of weather-related data for UI testing or demonstration purposes, including methods to retrieve a mock 'warm' index and related info encapsulated in a static inner class.

classes.name: MockWeatherProvider
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to retrieve mock weather data without network dependency.

classes.name: WarmInfo
classes.description: A static inner class representing temperature and related details for display in UI.

methods.name: getWarm
methods.description: Returns a mock 'warm' index value for demonstration purposes.

methods.name: getWarmInfo
methods.description: Returns a MockWarmInfo object containing mock details about the warm metric.
